name: Stripperella
description: From Stan Lee, the man who brought us such popular superheroes as Spider-Man and The X-Men, comes this new kind of superhero in the form of the animated series "Stripperella". Pamela Anderson provides the voice of Erotica Jones who is stripper by night and superhero Stripperella by even later at night. A show with something for everyone, Stan Lee promises that despite it's adult setting 'Stripperella' is "really a family show...but for a highly sophisticated family."

videos.title: Beauty and the Obese (1)
videos.overview: Stripperella goes undercover to probe the sudden fattening of several models and runs afoul of a nefarious plastic surgeon.

videos.title: Crime Doesn't Pay... Seriously, It Really Doesn't
videos.overview: Stripperella tries to thwart a thrifty villain called Cheapo.

videos.title: Everybody Loves Pushy
videos.overview: The heroine battles a home-shopping network whose products are made out of flesh.

videos.title: The Wrath of Klinko
videos.overview: The owner of a chain of copy stores uses his photocopy machines to brainwash customers into carrying out evil deeds.

videos.title: You Only Lick Twice
videos.overview: Stripperella rubs an evil queen the wrong way when she infiltrates the matriarch's secret cove to thwart her rampage against men.

videos.title: Beauty and the Obese (2)
videos.overview: The clock is ticking for Stripperella to prevent Dr. Cesarian from detonating a model with an explosive breast implant on live TV.

videos.title: The Bridesmaid
videos.overview: The Bridesmaid preys on the world's grooms.

videos.title: Evil Things Come in Small Packages
videos.overview: Stripperella tangles with Small Fry, a diminutive villain determined to shrink anyone larger than he is.

videos.title: Eruption Junction, What's Your Function
videos.overview: The disappearances of several teens on the eve of a science fair prompts Stripperella to pose as a high-school student to uncover the culprit.

videos.title: The Evil Magicians
videos.overview: Erotica and pals travel to Las Vegas when she's nominated for Stripper of the Year honors. The fun is waylaid, however, by an evil ventriloquist and his dummy.

videos.title: Cheapo by the Dozen
videos.overview: Stripperella draws on lady luck to thwart a scheme by cut-rate villain Cheapo to loot Las Vegas with an "Ocean's Eleven"-type gang.

videos.title: The Return of the Queen
videos.overview: The Queen's vengeful return proves a royal pain to Stripperella.

videos.title: The Curse of the WereBeaver
videos.overview: A man bitten by a radioactive beaver becomes a monstrous challenge for Stripperella when she tangles with the crazed Werebeaver.
